scope: Singular assertion-script output validation; compute.sh continues to own resource controls
snapshot: Initial verification before received-line flushing was added; the final flushing verification is preserved separately.
behavior: Preserves stdout/stderr bytes on completed runs, rejects native diagnostic lines and FAILED lines even before a later PASS, requires a final PASS token and zero process status. The assertion script checks its own expected count; the launcher does not prove mathematical correctness or infer that count.
tests: launcher-tests-final.txt: five native methods pass. Live fixtures exercise real Singular parser errors, a failed-check marker, missing/early/prefix completion, the direct API, default stdout, actual CLI and native invalid-option stderr. Nonzero-status acceptance is also checked directly in the pure result predicate.

unique_promises.completion: launcher-target-completion.txt: completion method's three subcases fail

targeted.control: The isolated clean control passed all five methods before any mutation. Source variants and complete named-test failure reports are preserved; no import/setup failure is counted as a kill.

generic.first_run: launcher-generic.txt: 51 killed, 11 survived; every surviving diff was read and preserved in launcher-survivor-diffs.txt
generic.gap_closure: Three behavioral survivors dropped merged stderr or selected None instead of default stdout: run_script7, run_script10, main19. Existing live tests were strengthened. The first recheck still survived because shell-generated output did not distinguish Singular's native stderr, and child CLI mutation context did not exercise the imported default-output branch. Native invalid-option stderr and the imported real default-output path distinguish both. launcher-generic-final.txt kills all three.
generic.equivalent: run_script1 changes initial False to None, both false and replaced by a Boolean when a line is classified. run_script4 changes initial empty bytes to XXXX; it still rejects absent/blank-only completion, and nonempty lines replace it.
generic.cosmetic: main2,main4,main6,main9,main10,main11 alter only argparse description/help wording, padding or case. No exact-help tests were added solely to kill those.
generic.cache_scope: Earlier kills are reused with the unchanged source. Explicit final recheck covers the three strengthened cases; launcher-all-mutations.txt preserves all final statuses. Generation measured 164 ms for one file, recheck 32 ms for the unchanged file; four test workers were used.

real_use: The five-method suite exercises real Singular scripts through the direct API, default output and actual CLI, including real parser diagnostics and native stderr. No mocked CAS responses are used; arbitrary mathematical scripts still need their own independent checks.
limits: The protocol is for assertion scripts. Other CAS programs and ordinary Singular data scripts are outside this completion-token interface; no automatic validation of every historical run is claimed.
